hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on at 2026-10-29T13:37:00Z. From that minute, account page requests that evaluated it as on failed with a ZeroDivisionError in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47, and the error rate rose from about 1-2% to about 30%. No deployment or other change was involved, and latency and traffic did not move.

supporting_evidence.claim: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on (actor: admin)
monthly-spend-feature=off 111 / on 89 - 200 evaluations; ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47; account page error rate at 17.50%
error_rate 0.025 at 13:36 stepped to 0.175 at 13:37 and stayed at 0.26-0.415, while p50, p95 and p99 stayed flat
Rollout has converged on all 3 replicas and the deployment history holds no deployment

The logs still show monthly-spend-feature=on at 13:44 and 13:45, after Argus set the flag off at 13:43:18, and the error rate stayed high. The off action had not taken effect in the evidence I read, so it does not count against the flag.
